game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Doubling Growth: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the supply cache fast.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.

win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 460, or lives reach 0.
